notes.title: Spoofs Playland Demo available now!
notes.notes:
The demo for Spoofs Playland is now available!

You can now try Spoofs Playland ahead of release, and even carry over your save data to the full game!
In the demo, you can play minigames, increase your bond level, collect decorations and toys, and more. 

Your playtime is limited to an hour and a half and certain modes and items in the shop are locked in the demo version. However, you can keep your save data and continue with your progress and creations intact in the final game.

We hope you enjoy a relaxing time together with the Spoofs!
-- the team at Madvox Games
